lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.31 - A Write and match

details: Write and match consolidates the written word-concept association and spelling.
Look for correct matching, correct spelling and neat handwriting.
“Let’s go on an animal safari today, and see how many animals we can find! I need you to help me remember all the animal names!”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.31 - B. Listen and choose

details: Listen and choose practises listening comprehension and auditory discrimination by matching the spoken sentence to the correct picture.
Look for attentive listening, correct and neat circling, and check that all students are on task.
“We have a guide with us, to tell us about some of the animals!”

Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.85 - A Look and circle

details: Look and circle tests students’ observational skills by challenging them to complete a sequence and choosing the correct alternative.
Look for correct choices and neat circling.
“Look over there! Can you just see one horse/ Or are there lots of horses?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.85 - B Look and tick

details: Look and tick helps pupils consolidate the differences in meaning between the four demonstrative pronouns.
Look for correct choices and a clear understanding of the distinction between both singular / plural and near / far.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.32 - Speaking Bottle run

details: Bottle run is a kinesthetic way of helping students consolidate the concepts of ‘these’ and ‘those’ in an authentic context, as well as revising the target vocabulary (animals).
Look for correct production of the target grammar (questions and answers) and vocabulary (animals), and correct comprehension.
“We’re getting to the end of our safari. But there’s still a few more animals to find. Can you work together to get close to them?
